Exploring the official @Tesla dealership in Bonifacio Global City, Philippines! 🇵🇭 I was surprised to see a gorgeous "Glacier Blue" Model Y—what a color! We also got a look at the software version (V12) and the supercharger rates: 19 pesos per kWh with a 20-minute time limit, or you'll pay a congestion fee! 🤯

A few key takeaways: Tesla doesn't offer in-house financing here, and the interest rates I've heard about can be quite high (up to 22%). Many people just buy cash. But the most shocking part? They don't service or support Model S, Model X, or the Cybertruck! Tesla has to officially sell it for them to maintain it. This is the ultimate insider look at the Tesla ownership experience in the Philippines!

Full video - https://t.co/4zlDcRNByZ
